title: CONAIE internal assembly on 17 March announcing future sit-ins
reason: Restricted internal meeting, explicitly described as not mass; announced future sit-ins are unverified
notes: Primicias says the meeting was restricted and not mass (body lines 306–308). Its reported claim that 81 organizations participated is not a crowd count. The self-called sit-ins at the Constitutional Court and National Assembly were future resolutions, not completed public gatherings. Keep occurrence of any subsequent sit-in open in G013.
